name: ITPI Size Discount
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) ITPI rating table, loaded by P22 from verticals/antipodean/reference/. Held as records rather than inlined in the engine flow so a rate change is an edit, not a deploy. Ten revenue bands, 0% to 80%. The top band ends at $25,000,000 while QuestionSet_v1 refers any revenue over $15,000,000 to an underwriter, so bands 10 and part of 9 only ever rate a referred risk. Band 1's revenue_min is 0, and the index reads min:0 and max:0 as 'not supplied' — only exact:0 finds it. A band lookup for a revenue under $100,000 must therefore filter on revenue_max alone, or the engine will silently miss the band that most small risks fall in.

band_id.description: Synthetic key, itpi_size_01..10 — the sheet has none.

revenue_min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Band 1's '$-' is stored as 0.

discount_percent.description: Percentage as stated (10 means 10%), NOT a fraction.
